name: xh2m
description: SMTP/POP3 ↔ HTTP email proxy — localhost bridge for mail clients

scripts.build: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p dist && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/xh2m-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/xh2m-darwin-x64 && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/xh2m-linux-arm64 && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/xh2m-linux-x64 && if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then for bin in dist/xh2m-darwin-arm64 dist/xh2m-darwin-x64; do nix_icu="$(otool -L "$bin" | grep "/nix/store.*libicucore" | awk "{print \$1}" || true)"; if [ -n "$nix_icu" ]; then install_name_tool -change "$nix_icu" /usr/lib/libicucore.A.dylib "$bin" && codesign -f -s - "$bin"; fi; done; fi'
